subject: RFQ Request - Hydraulic Manifold Block - Project Titan
body:
Hello Procurement Team,

We need to initiate a Request for Quote (RFQ) for a critical component in Project Titan.

**Part Details:**
- Part Name: Hydraulic Manifold Block
- Part Number: HYD-MANIFOLD-001
- Initial Quantity: 150 units
- Annual Volume: 500 units/year
- Material: 6061-T6 Aluminum

**Requirements:**
- Delivery Date: 8 weeks from today (March 5, 2024)
- Special Requirement: Leak test at 3000 PSI
- ITAR Compliance: Domestic suppliers only (US-based manufacturing required)

**Attachments:**
- Engineering drawing (PDF)
- CAD file (STEP format)
- Material specification document

Please coordinate with suppliers and provide quotes by January 22, 2024.

Thank you,
Sarah Chen
Engineering Department
